NewsArticle.Title: Mileth Fair King & Queen Vote
NewsArticle.Content: .04.30 The Mileth Fair King & Queen entrants: - Fireborn & BioMagus - JosephIV & Treesa - Lane & PikaGenesis - LeGalle & Raeven - Manipulator & Kamyra - Sarc & Diamanda - Tellah & Lori - Twila & Drakkarim - Vivid & Nando - Xilan & Lethalia All citizens or Temuair are invited to vote on their favorite choices. You may cast your vote in Rucesion with Antonio in the bank or in Mileth with Riona at the Mileth Inn. The Mileth Fair Committee and Cedric, Mileth Mundane Burgess would like to thank all of those aislings that participated in this event. The judging was not an easy task as all essays submitted were equally great. Each and every one of you glow with the true aisling spark. -Mileth Fair Committee -Cedric, Mileth Mundane Burgess ((Voting will end after 00.04.30 ))
